purpose: Repo-root entrypoint for discoverable eval suites, their generated artifacts, and the commands that produce reports.

suites.title: Attempt readiness loop evals
suites.summary: Evaluates bounded repo evidence, simulated user answers, gap labels, repair actions, re-evaluation prompts, and readiness labels.

suites.title: WorkspacePlan adapter evals
suites.summary: Evaluates WorkspaceIntent parsing, provider-neutral model IO normalization, WorkspacePlan validation, Rust fixture execution, and offline Codex runner metadata.

suites.title: Pedagogy layer coverage evals
suites.summary: Evaluates deterministic pedagogy cases and semantic coverage for layers, answer classes, gap labels, operations, evidence conditions, and loop stages.

suites.title: Shared core boundary guardrails
suites.summary: Evaluates deterministic import boundaries for shared core and Sibi plus the global gates declared by the shared core boundary spec.
